description: Searches GigXchange's help articles — its own documentation of how the platform works (payments, fees, deposits, cancellations, bookings, profiles, messages, account, what to do when something goes wrong). Returns matching articles with their url, or no results when the help centre does not cover a topic.

query.description: What the member wants to know, in their own words.

role.description: Optional: the member's role (artist, venue, agent, promoter, organiser) so role-specific articles rank first.

name: search_help
title: Search GigXchange help
